mapper.sql:
ADSI_NM AS "adstdgNm"
(SELECT CD_NM FROM M_OP_CODE MOC WHERE GRP_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' AND SUBSTRING(CD_ID,0,5) = SUBSTRING(ADSTDG_CD, 0, 5)) AS "adstdgNm"
,COALESCE(SUM(ACDNT_CNT),0) AS "acdntCnt"
mapper.select:
SELECT
,'BCYCL' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_bcycl_acdnt_dstrct /* 자전거 사고 구역 */
UNION SELECT
,'JAYWK' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_jaywk_pdst_acdnt_dstrct /*무단횡단 보행자 사고구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'LAWVLTN' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_law_vltn_pdst_acdnt_dstrct /*법위반 보행자 사고구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'HLDY' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_hldy_period_acdnt_dstrct /*휴일기간 보행자 사고구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'FROST' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_frost_acdnt_dstrct /*결빙사고 구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'TWHLVH' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_twhlvh_acdnt_dstrct /*이륜차 사고 구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'PDSN' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_pdsn_acdnt_dstrct /*보행자 사고 구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'DRNKG' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_drnkg_acdnt_dstrct /*음주 사고 구역*/
UNION SELECT CLCT_DT ,ACDNT_DSTRCT_IDENTIFIER ,ACDNT_DSTRCT_ID ,ADSTDG_CD ,SUBSTRING(ADSTDG_CD,0,5) as sgg_cd ,POINT_CD ,ADSI_NM ,POINT_NM ,ACDNT_CNT ,CASLT_CNT ,DCSD_CNT ,SWPSN_CNT ,SINJPSN_CNT ,INJ_DCLR_CNT ,LON_CRDN ,LAT_CRDN ,ST_ASGEOJSON(ACDNT_DSTRCT_PYN) AS ACDNT_DSTRCT_PYN ,'TRUCK' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_truck_acdnt_dstrct /*화물차 사고 구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'OLMAN' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_pdst_olman_acdnt_dstrct /*노인 보행자 사고 구역*/
UNION SELECT
,'CHILD' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.ext_taas_pdst_chid_acdnt_dstrct /*어린이 보행자 사고 구역*/

SELECT SUM(ACDNT_CNT) AS "acdntCnt"
,ADSI_NM AS "adstdgNm" ,ADSTDG_CD AS "adstdgCd"
,(SELECT CD_NM FROM M_OP_CODE MOC WHERE GRP_CD_ID = 'SGG_CD' AND SUBSTRING(CD_ID,0,5) = SUBSTRING(ADSTDG_CD, 0, 5)) AS "adstdgNm" ,SUBSTRING(ADSTDG_CD, 0, 5) as "adstdgCd"
FROM (SELECT
,'BCYCL' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_bcycl_acdnt_dstrct /* 자전거 사고 구역 */ UNION SELECT
,'JAYWK' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_jaywk_pdst_acdnt_dstrct /*무단횡단 보행자 사고구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'LAWVLTN' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_law_vltn_pdst_acdnt_dstrct /*법위반 보행자 사고구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'HLDY' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_hldy_period_acdnt_dstrct /*휴일기간 보행자 사고구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'FROST' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_frost_acdnt_dstrct /*결빙사고 구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'TWHLVH' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_twhlvh_acdnt_dstrct /*이륜차 사고 구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'PDSN' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_pdsn_acdnt_dstrct /*보행자 사고 구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'DRNKG' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_drnkg_acdnt_dstrct /*음주 사고 구역*/ UNION SELECT CLCT_DT ,ACDNT_DSTRCT_IDENTIFIER ,ACDNT_DSTRCT_ID ,ADSTDG_CD ,POINT_CD ,ADSI_NM ,POINT_NM ,ACDNT_CNT ,CASLT_CNT ,DCSD_CNT ,SWPSN_CNT ,SINJPSN_CNT ,INJ_DCLR_CNT ,LON_CRDN ,LAT_CRDN ,ST_ASGEOJSON(ACDNT_DSTRCT_PYN) AS ACDNT_DSTRCT_PYN ,'TRUCK' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_truck_acdnt_dstrct /*화물차 사고 구역*/ UNION SELECT
,'OLMAN' AS TYPE FROM BIGDATA.EXT_taas_pdst_olman_acdnt_dstrct /*노인 보행자 사고 구역*/ ) C GROUP BY "adstdgNm" , "adstdgCd" ORDER BY "acdntCnt" DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_BCYCL_ACDNT_DSTRCT /* 자전거 사고 구역 */ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_JAYWK_PDST_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*무단횡단 보행자 사고구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_LAW_VLTN_PDST_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*법위반 보행자 사고구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_HLDY_PERIOD_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*휴일기간 보행자 사고구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_FROST_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*결빙사고 구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_TWHLVH_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*이륜차 사고 구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_PDSN_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*보행자 사고 구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_DRNKG_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*음주 사고 구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_TRUCK_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*화물차 사고 구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') AS "year" FROM BIGDATA.EXT_TAAS_PDST_OLMAN_ACDNT_DSTRCT /*노인 보행자 사고 구역*/ GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CLCT_DT,'YYYY') ORDER BY YEAR DESC
